text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning! Man, the new volume had 
such a heart-pounding sudden twist—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, no!! Um, I was reading, and then, 
well, it was morning... ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
O-Oops... I need to tighten up my facial 
muscles—

Stifling a yawn from lack of sleep, Mejiro 
Ryan headed toward the school gates.
